summary.ja: 3固定seedの49パラメータPINNを解析解・FDと比較します。
summary.en: Compare a 49-parameter PINN for three fixed seeds with analytic and finite-difference solutions.

assumptions.ja: 無次元区間[0,1]で −uₓₓ=π²sin(πx)、u(0)=u(1)=0。中間層16素子・49実パラメータ、固定seed 8401–8403、学習64点と独立評価257点を用います。
assumptions.en: Solve dimensionless −uₓₓ=π² sin(πx) on [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data. Use sixteen hidden units, 49 real parameters, seeds 8401–8403, 64 training points and 257 separate evaluation points.

algorithm.ja: x(1−x)を掛けて境界値を厳密に組み込むtanhネットワークを、解析的な全パラメータJacobian付きTRF最小二乗法で学習します。固定予算後の全モデルを保存し、31/63/127未知数の2次中心差分とThomas法も計算します。
algorithm.en: Train a hard-boundary tanh ansatz with trust-region reflective least squares and an analytic parameter Jacobian. Retain every returned model under the fixed budget. Also solve second-order finite differences with 31, 63 and 127 unknowns using the Thomas algorithm.

validation.ja: 全49列の残差Jacobianと損失勾配、空間微分を別資格段階で独立照合。解析解sin(πx)に対する独立点誤差、PDE残差、境界値、FD誤差を別に保存します。収束・精度目標の実際の真偽を残し、正常な予算終了を収束と呼びません。
validation.en: Independently qualify all 49 residual-Jacobian columns, loss-gradient coordinates and spatial derivatives. Save off-training solution error against sin(πx), PDE residual, boundary error and finite-difference error separately. Preserve actual convergence and accuracy decisions; a normal budget return is not convergence.

limits.ja: 1つの滑らかなPoisson問題と3seedの固定予算実験です。小さい学習損失だけで独立点精度の達成や一般的なPINN学習成功を保証しません。未達目標も表示します。
limits.en: This fixed-budget study covers one smooth Poisson problem and three seeds. A small training loss does not establish independent-point accuracy or general PINN training success. Unmet goals remain visible.

title.en: Tiny FNO on held-out heat problems

summary.ja: 同じ重みで32/64点・未見関数・OODを分けて評価します。
summary.en: Evaluate the same learned weights on 32/64-point grids, held-out functions and separate OOD inputs.

assumptions.ja: 周期区間[0,2π)、uₜ=νuₓₓ、T=0.25。同じ関数の点を分散させず、全46問題を学習24・検証6・未見ID8・νのOOD4・周波数のOOD4に分けます。2固定seed、93実パラメータです。
assumptions.en: Use periodic heat flow uₜ=νuₓₓ on [0,2π) to T=0.25. Split 46 whole problems into 24 training, 6 validation, 8 held-out ID, 4 viscosity-OOD and 4 spectrum-OOD problems. Use two fixed seeds and 93 real parameters.

algorithm.ja: 入力(u₀,ν)を幅2へ写し、局所線形項・DCと1–4モードの複素Fourier項・tanhからなる2ブロックを適用します。L-BFGS-Bの固定予算で学習し、同じ重みをN=32/64へ転送。非線形項は各格子上で評価しdealiasingしません。
algorithm.en: Lift (u₀,ν) to width two and apply two blocks containing a local linear map, real DC and complex Fourier modes 1–4, then tanh. Train with a fixed L-BFGS-B budget and evaluate the same weights at N=32 and 64. Nonlinear terms are evaluated on each native grid without dealiasing.

validation.ja: 全93実座標の損失勾配を2つの固定差分幅で照合し、Fourierブロックを直接DFTと比較。解析的な熱モード減衰に対する絶対・相対誤差、格子制限差、ID/OODを分離します。参照RMS≤10⁻¹²では相対誤差をNAとし、ゼロ・微小振幅では絶対誤差を保存します。
validation.en: Qualify all 93 real loss-gradient coordinates at two fixed finite-difference widths and compare Fourier blocks with direct DFT sums. Separate analytic heat-mode errors, grid-restriction differences and ID/OOD diagnostics. Relative error is NA when reference RMS≤10⁻¹²; zero and near-zero controls retain absolute errors.

limits.ja: 固定された小型離散作用素の比較で、任意の解像度・分布に対する一般化やOOD精度を保証しません。N=64から32への差には非線形aliasingが含まれ、連続体離散化誤差とは呼びません。最適化収束と固定予算終了は別です。
limits.en: This comparison concerns a fixed tiny discrete operator, without arbitrary-resolution, distributional or OOD guarantees. The N=64-to-32 discrepancy includes nonlinear aliasing and is not a continuum discretization error. Optimizer convergence is distinct from normal budget termination.

summary.ja: 全4状態と準定常近似を比較し、初期層と積分誤差を分けます。
summary.en: Separate the initial layer, integration error and QSSA modeling error in a four-state enzyme mechanism.

assumptions.ja: 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。
assumptions.en: Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5.

algorithm.ja: 全4状態をSDIRK2のstep doublingで積分し、各段のNewton法では同じ重み付きL∞残差とArmijo条件を使います。縮約Michaelis–Menten式はθ上の別RK4計算で求め、全系の積分誤差と近似モデル誤差を混同しません。
algorithm.en: Integrate all four states with SDIRK2 step doubling, using the same weighted L∞ residual for Newton convergence and Armijo backtracking. Evolve the reduced Michaelis–Menten equation separately with RK4 in θ, keeping integration error distinct from model-reduction error.

validation.ja: 独立な全系Radau/BDF参照、縮約式の陰的スカラー恒等式、E+C=E₀とS+C+P=1、正値性、実際の採用・棄却・Newton作業を照合。初期層を含む全時間と、事前指定θ≥0.02の近似誤差を別保存します。
validation.en: Compare with independent full-system Radau/BDF references and an implicit scalar identity for the reduced equation. Check E+C=E₀, S+C+P=1, positivity and actual acceptance, rejection and Newton work. Retain both all-time errors including the initial layer and errors on the declared θ≥0.02 window.

limits.ja: 2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
limits.en: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

summary.ja: 正の軌道を独立な対数座標参照と比較します。
summary.en: Compare a positive orbit against an independently integrated log-coordinate reference.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の捕食者・被食者系x′=x(1−y)、y′=y(x−1)、初期値(1.2,0.8)、0≤t≤20。正の象限で不変量H=x−log x+y−log yを評価します。
assumptions.en: Use the dimensionless predator–prey equations x′=x(1−y), y′=y(x−1), initial state (1.2,0.8) and 0≤t≤20. Evaluate H=x−log x+y−log y only in the positive quadrant.

algorithm.ja: 固定400/800/1600ステップの古典RK4で物理状態を積分します。独立参照はlog x・log yの変数でRadau/BDFを実行し、主計算には対数変数や保存量の射影を導入しません。
algorithm.en: Integrate physical populations with classical RK4 at 400, 800 and 1600 fixed steps. Independent Radau/BDF references evolve log x and log y; the primary method uses neither a log-coordinate update nor invariant projection.

validation.ja: 独立参照との状態誤差、Hのドリフト、保存された軌道の最小値を別々に測定。参照側では解析Jacobian、Radau/BDF差、刻み精度、Hの時間微分の恒等式を事前資格しています。
validation.en: Measure state error against the independent reference, drift of H and the minimum saved population separately. The reference stage qualifies analytic Jacobians, Radau/BDF agreement, tolerance refinement and the identity dH/dt=0.

limits.ja: 1初期値・有限時間の固定比較です。連続系の閉軌道を引き込み極限周期とは呼びません。RK4の厳密な不変量保存、任意刻みでの正値性、長時間の構造保存は保証しません。
limits.en: This is a finite-time comparison for one initial state. The continuum closed orbit is not an attracting limit cycle. RK4 is not claimed to preserve H exactly, maintain positivity at arbitrary steps or guarantee long-time geometric fidelity.

summary.ja: 人口保存と2モードの初期線形化を別々に検査します。
summary.en: Check population conservation and the full two-mode initial linearization separately.

assumptions.en: Use a closed population S+E+I+R=1 with β=0.6, σ=0.3 and γ=0.2. For η=10⁻⁴ or 5×10⁻⁵, start from (1−2η,η,η,0) and evolve to t=20. There are no births, deaths or external inflows.

algorithm.ja: 全4状態を固定400/800/1600ステップのRK4で積分。独立非線形参照は偏差をηで尺度化してRadau/BDFで求め、早期のE・I線形化は2×2行列指数の両モードを使います。
algorithm.en: Evolve all four physical states with RK4 at 400, 800 and 1600 fixed steps. Independently compute the nonlinear reference with scaled-deviation Radau/BDF and the early E/I linearization with both modes of the full 2×2 matrix exponential.

validation.ja: t≤20の全ODE積分誤差・人口保存・非負性と、0≤t≤1の201参照点での線形化モデル誤差を分けます。参照では両ηの尺度付きJacobian、Radau/BDF差とη²に対する余裕、解析的な全行列指数を別資格しています。
validation.en: Separate full-ODE integration error, population conservation and nonnegativity through t=20 from linearization-model error at 201 reference points on 0≤t≤1. Qualify scaled Jacobians, Radau/BDF agreement with an η² margin and the analytic full matrix exponential independently.

limits.ja: 2つの小初期感染量による固定係数の整合性比較です。早期線形化をt=20全体の厳密解と見なさず、単一の優勢モードで両モードを置き換えません。実流行の予測・統計的被覆・任意人口への一般保証は行いません。
limits.en: These fixed-coefficient calculations compare two small initial infection levels. The early linearization is not an exact solution through t=20, and a single dominant mode does not replace the two-mode solution. No epidemic forecast, statistical coverage or arbitrary-population guarantee is claimed.
